fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2013 Ford F-350 box truck, which we can detail.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on the front
Dull, slightly faded black plastic grille and front bumper
Water staining and dark marks on the wood paneling of the cargo box walls
Light grime and streaking on the white box exterior and side door
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-350 box truck. The headlights look a bit yellowed and the black grille and bumper have faded some, and the cargo box could use a good clean-out. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight and trim restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
